concerns.claim: monthly_revenue applies tax on top of Invoice.total(), which now already includes tax, so taxed invoices are taxed twice in the month-end revenue report.
concerns.why: Before the PR total() was pre-tax and monthly_revenue's docstring relies on that. After it, total() multiplies by (1 + tax_rate) and the caller multiplies again.

concerns.claim: apply_discount now discounts the tax-inclusive total, which changes what customers pay when a code is used.
concerns.why: The override is computed from total(), which now includes tax; whether discounts apply before or after tax is a business rule.

concerns.claim: The payments service probably double-charges too.
concerns.why: Guess: this file was never shown, so the claim cannot be checked and must be dropped.

concerns.claim: export_csv writes total() and ignores total_override, so exported invoices lose any applied discount, unlike payable().
concerns.why: payable() returns total_override when a discount code was applied; export_csv bypasses it.
